svg.text: Call flow 3 of 3 — the fusion tick, the assessment and the warning
The tick runs on its period whether or not anything arrived, so a track can expire and risk can fall on silence alone.
Emission is edge-triggered in both directions: every committed change of the risk state for one warning type and track sends exactly one warning event, and steady state sends
nothing. The message set carries no explicit clear event, so the transition back down is how the display learns to stop warning.
The plugin never emits. It returns a finding and the output stage decides transport, which is what keeps the rules replaceable without touching the wire.
expire tracks silent past the timeout
nearest own-sensor VehicleB, tracked relayed VehicleC
compose d_AC, the closing rate, the time to collision, then the band
no own-sensor VehicleB: rationale b_unknown, risk stays low
a risk finding, once the change has held for the dwell
